structured.answer: I'd open an account at Psagot and buy the 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)' fund. At 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ put in), the page says I'd end up with about 179,889 ₪ in today's money. That uses 7% a year and assumes 2% inflation a year.

stuck.where: Line under the sliders: 'בכסף של היום'
stuck.why: It says the result is in today's money but doesn't show the inflation number. I had to guess that the 'אינפלציה' button was where to find it.
The first pair is only 43–122 ₪ better than the next one, so I wasn't sure the choice matters.

findings.what: The inflation assumption (2%) is hidden behind a button. The main line just says 'בכסף של היום' with no rate.
The page moved up about 42 px after I typed the years.
The top two pairs differ by only 43–122 ₪, which leaves the 'cheapest' choice feeling arbitrary
Lots of jargon chips I can't use (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח)
The fund manager name, ילין לפידות, is less familiar to me than the banks
